subtitle: 从你的聊天里，读出你没说出口的安排
description: 拾意读取你聊天里的一条消息，认出藏在里面的时间、地点与待办，做成一张等你点头的卡片；你确认后它去执行，并记住你的长期偏好，下次自动调整建议。Agent 干活，人保留控制。
release_notes: 0.3.3 — the bundle now asks for three host services. The opening screen still asks the device assistant what the message leaves out (octos.session.open, octos.turn.start), and it now also asks Rinx's mini-app host to post one line into the room chosen at import (matrix.send_message), so a reading can leave the card and reach the chat. Nothing here depends on a call succeeding: every read sits behind a boolean guard, and a host that serves none of these draws the same card, unchanged. Gate on the Linux hub: hub check PASSED — grants {matrix.send_message, octos.session.open, octos.turn.start}. The cards themselves are unchanged from 0.3.2.
